title: Staff of the Emperor

sources.title: Arcane Enchantment (+1)
markers: | description = You gain a +1 bonus to [[Spell Save DC]] and [[Spell Attack]] rolls.

sources.title: Imperial Retaliation
markers: | description = When the wielder succeeds a {{Saving Throw}}, the foe that caused the throw needs to make an {{Saving Throw|Intelligence}} or be {{cond|Stunned}} for 1 turn.

summary: +2 staff improves spellcasting and can stun enemy casters.

fields.Weapon profile: Simple, Versatile, 5 ft melee, Dippable. 1d6 + 2 one-handed or 1d8 + 2 two-handed Bludgeoning plus Strength. +2 to attack rolls.
fields.Arcane Enchantment: +1 spell attack rolls and spell save DC.
fields.Imperial Retaliation: When you succeed on a save against a hostile spell, its caster makes a DC 15 Intelligence save or becomes Stunned for 1 turn.
fields.Acquisition: Disarm the Emperor in the Astral Plane at the Act Two to Three transition. Command and Fear only work if the Emperor is made hostile.
fields.Topple: With proficiency, once per Short Rest. Action, weapon attack for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. DEX save against weapon-action DC +2 or Prone for 1 turn. Prone breaks Concentration and expires at the start of the target’s turn. Topple skips main-hand weapon effects.
fields.Stunned: Cannot move, act or react and automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves. Attackers gain Advantage. Stun breaks Concentration. Freedom of Movement, Greater Restoration and Unshackling Strike can remove it.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
